implementation_owner: Release Integrity where machinery/schema changes are required

requirements.defect: The generated source registry is an inventory of older authoritative source namespaces and does not ingest source objects from accepted canonical v2 update packets. Its generated_at value is 2026-08-22 while accepted canonical evidence extends through September.
requirements.required_factual_behavior: The incorporated-source registry must cover every source referenced by the accepted canonical lineage, including sources introduced by accepted v2 packets, or must explicitly expose a registry cutoff older than the canonical cutoff. A source referenced by canonical evidence may not silently lack registry provenance.
requirements.do_not_do: Do not turn the standing collection-source universe into the incorporated-source registry; they serve different functions.

requirements.defect: Composite outlet labels can collapse the person/organization that originated evidence with the site that republishes or hosts it.
requirements.required_factual_behavior: Preserve separately: originator, publisher/outlet, republisher/host, retrieval URL, original URL when known, and evidentiary role. A republished wire story remains originated by the wire; a government statement quoted by an NGO remains a government-origin proposition embedded in an NGO source.

examples.required_relationship: Split into distinct source/proposition records unless a single retrieved artifact genuinely contains both. Airwars is an independent monitoring NGO; U.S. Embassy Manama is a U.S. government primary source.

requirements.do_not_do: Do not create one pseudo-outlet identity that inherits attributes from both organizations.

requirements.defect: The builder override correctly identifies Tasnim as Iranian/state-aligned, but the generated profile for 'Tasnim News Agency' can fall through alias normalization and appear with null country / GLOBAL_INTERNATIONAL.
requirements.do_not_do: Do not treat state affiliation as a universal reliability score. Tasnim is high-value primary evidence for what it/linked Iranian actors publicly claimed.

requirements.defect: SIDR demonstrates occurrence/report conflation: the Aug. 31 attack was stored as a Sep. 7 event because Sep. 7 was the later Oman rescue/status report.
requirements.required_factual_behavior: Every event model must preserve occurrence time/date, first-report/publication time, evidence-availability time, Atlas known_at/correction time, and later status/correction time separately where available.
requirements.required_guard: A rescue, casualty revision, BDA update or investigation publication may update an existing occurrence but may not silently replace the occurrence date.
requirements.test_case: G3-SAUDI-TANKER-OMAN-RESCUE-20260907 must remain one stable occurrence identity with corrected occurrence_date=2026-08-31 and later_status_date=2026-09-07.

requirements.defect: Later evidence can strengthen asset/event disposition after an initially correct lower-confidence state, but current event machinery provides no update path.
requirements.required_factual_behavior: Allow later evidence to append a revision to the same stable event/asset without erasing the earlier assessment. Preserve the transition and when each state became supportable.
requirements.automatic_truth_rule: A cue creates a reconciliation candidate only. Human evidence adjudication decides whether status changes.
current_examples: G3-IRAN-JORDAN-BASE-ATTACK-20260908: damage unestablished at cutoff → later aircraft damage established while exact BDA remains source-bounded

requirements.defect: Gate 3 v2 entity records support mode=update, but chronology events reject duplicate IDs and expose no same-event update semantics.
requirements.required_factual_behavior: Release machinery must support stable event revision with field-level previous/new values, effective occurrence time, correction known_at, supporting source IDs and analytical-meaning flag while retaining the prior accepted state.
requirements.do_not_do: Do not create a second occurrence solely to work around append-only chronology.

requirements.defect: A sampled set of high-value URLs was live, but a deterministic full registry liveness/redirect/archive state is not evidence-owned today.
requirements.required_factual_behavior: Track URL lifecycle separately from evidentiary meaning: LIVE, REDIRECTED, MOVED, DEAD, ARCHIVED_COPY, SUPERSEDED. Preserve old URLs and archive references rather than rewriting source history.
requirements.do_not_do: A dead URL does not make previously preserved evidence false; it creates a retrieval/provenance maintenance issue.

relationship_semantics.state_media: Can be primary evidence of actor/state-media publication or quotation; not independent corroboration of the claimed event.
relationship_semantics.official_source: Can be primary legal/administrative authority for its own action and primary evidence of its own claim; outcome/effect still may require independent or physical evidence.
relationship_semantics.wire_service: Secondary evidence; retain whether reporting rests on on-record official, anonymous official, multiple sources, imagery, or provider data.
relationship_semantics.commercial_tracking: Provider-specific observation; preserve visibility/AIS/coverage limits and never silently equate with all physical traffic.
relationship_semantics.satellite_or_sensor: Primary technical observation of what the sensor shows; attribution/intent may remain separate.
